codeReview.summary: The feature implementation covers the requested scope: GET /api/users/me plus category CRUD with user scoping, validation, duplicate handling, delete blocking when transactions exist, and substantial unit/integration test coverage.

issues.description: Controller methods dereference @AuthenticationPrincipal without null checks. If X-User-Id points to a non-existent user, FakeAuthFilter leaves SecurityContext unauthenticated and these endpoints can return 500 (NPE) instead of a clear auth/user error response.

Integration tests use fixed category names against a persistent PostgreSQL test DB and do not clean up test data in this commit, so re-running the suite can produce false 409 conflicts from leftover rows.
